title: Structural and mechanistic insights into the anti-tyrosinase, anti-melanogenesis, and anti-browning effect of proanthocyanidins from seed coats of Acer truncatum Bunge.
authors: Huang, Jiangping; Li, Meiting; Han, Chengyun; Zhang, Zhongwei; Liu, Xiang; Ying, Zhixuan; Yin, Peipei; Yang, Lingguang
one_liner_zh: 研究元宝枫种皮原花青素对酪氨酸酶的抑制及抗黑色素生成作用，涉及分子对接与动态模拟，但对象为酶-小分子互作，非蛋白质-DNA体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Acer truncatum is a multifunctional tree species with broad applications in ornamental, healthy drink, and seed oil. In the present study, proanthocyanidins were isolated from the seed coats of A. truncatum, which were largely discarded as industrial wastes in seed oil production. Meanwhile, structural features, effects and mechanisms of anti-tyrosinase, anti-melanogenesis, and anti-browning of A. truncatum seed coat proanthocyanidins (ASPs) were systematically investigated. The joint application of FT-IR, MALDI-TOF-MS, hiolysis-coupled reverse-phase LC-ESI-MS, together with normal-phase LC confirmed that ASPs were predominately constituted by procyanidins with a mean polymerization degree of 12.09. Furthermore, ASPs powerfully inhibited both monophenolase and diphenolase activities of tyrosinase, and the inhibition of diphenolase was proved to be reversible and competitive-uncompetitive mixed type. Analyses of fluorescence quenching, UV spectra, and copper-ion chelation indicated that ASPs could inhibit tyrosinase in varied stages, and molecular docking and dynamic simulation further revealed the interaction mode between ASPs and tyrosinase. Cell assays further suggested that ASPs exhibited a strong inhibition against intracellular tyrosinase activity and melanin production through suppressing the expression of tyrosinase and microphthalmia transcription factor (MITF) at transcription level and caused apoptosis in B16F10 cells at higher concentrations. Antioxidant and anti-browning studies demonstrated that ASPs possessed high capacities of antioxidant, and potently suppress the browning of fresh-cut potatoes. Therefore, this study confirmed that seed coats of Acer truncatum is a potential natural source of tyrosinase, melanogenesis, and browning inhibitor, which provided a theoretical basis for the utilization of ASPs in the cosmetics, pharmaceutical, and food industries.
abstract_zh: 元宝枫（Acer truncatum）是一种多功能树种，在观赏、健康饮品及种子油等方面具有广泛应用。本研究从元宝枫种皮中分离出原花青素，这些种皮在种子油生产中大多作为工业废弃物被丢弃。同时，系统研究了元宝枫种皮原花青素（ASPs）的结构特征、抗酪氨酸酶、抗黑色素生成及抗褐变的作用与机制。结合FT-IR、MALDI-TOF-MS、硫解偶联反相LC-ESI-MS及正相LC的联合应用证实，ASPs主要由原花青素构成，平均聚合度为12.09。此外，ASPs强烈抑制酪氨酸酶的单酚酶和二酚酶活性，且对二酚酶的抑制被证明是可逆的竞争性-非竞争性混合型。荧光猝灭、紫外光谱及铜离子螯合分析表明，ASPs可在不同阶段抑制酪氨酸酶，分子对接和动态模拟进一步揭示了ASPs与酪氨酸酶之间的相互作用模式。细胞实验进一步表明，ASPs通过抑制酪氨酸酶及小眼畸形转录因子（MITF）在转录水平的表达，对细胞内酪氨酸酶活性和黑色素生成表现出强烈抑制作用，并在较高浓度下诱导B16F10细胞凋亡。抗氧化和抗褐变研究表明，ASPs具有高抗氧化能力，并能有效抑制鲜切马铃薯的褐变。因此，本研究证实元宝枫种皮是酪氨酸酶、黑色素生成及褐变抑制剂的潜在天然来源，为ASPs在化妆品、制药及食品工业中的应用提供了理论基础。
